author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
This is candle ice. It forms as individual ice crystals grow downward in a lake, pushing impurities into the seams and creating long, pure columns. When spring melts begin at these grain boundaries, the slab cracks apart, producing the distinctive clinking sound.
